incident.user_visible_problem: The router accepted a manual account switch, but the lower-left profile area did not change.
incident.root_cause: The lower-left profile control represented the fixed App Server login identity, while the router account panel used an independent routing state source.
incident.intermediate_r99_observation: The current-route badge rendered, but the account group did not attach because the upstream accessibility tree inferred a menu role that was not present as a DOM role attribute.
incident.repair: Keep the upstream login control intact, add a sanitized current-route badge, locate the open profile menu from stable menuitem descendants, and render the router accounts as native-style menuitemradio controls.

deployment.r99_first_attempt: rolled_back_before_activation because server and workstation zlib produced different gzip byte hashes
deployment.r99_retry: success after pinning the observed server gzip hashes

residual_risks: Every accepted manual switch starts a new backend session; no previous request, stream, session, in-flight work or computation is resumed.
